content.json:
## AKS cluster fingerprint — analyst view

One cluster, 30 days, from the Defender XDR advanced hunting schema. Alerts and incidents (open **and** closed), admission decisions, runtime process and DNS behaviour, and the exposure-graph neighbourhood that tells you what the cluster can reach.

_Pick a cluster and a time range. Namespace filters the runtime sections._

_Each tab loads its first panels automatically and keeps the rest behind a **Load more panels** button. That is deliberate: advanced hunting rate-limits per minute, and a tab that fires a dozen queries at once comes back as `429`._

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.label: Cluster
parameters.query:
// A cluster id is exactly 9 segments. EntityIds also carries CHILD resources
// (role assignments live under the cluster), so without this the picker fills
// with GUIDs that are not clusters.
let isCluster = (s: string) { s has '/managedclusters/' and array_length(split(s, '/')) == 9 };
// only two telemetry legs: CloudDnsEvents and CloudAuditEvents are the biggest
// tables and surface no cluster that process or admission events miss
let runtime = union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(AzureResourceId: string)[]),
    (CloudProcessEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | distinct AzureResourceId),
    (CloudPolicyEnforcementEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | distinct AzureResourceId)
    | where isnotempty(AzureResourceId)
    | extend Id = tolower(AzureResourceId)
    | where isCluster(Id)
    | distinct Id
    | extend Source = 'sensor';
let graph = ExposureGraphNodes
    | where NodeLabel =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters'
    | mv-expand E = EntityIds
    | extend Id = tolower(tostring(E.id))
    | where isCluster(Id)
    | distinct Id
    | extend Source = 'graph';
union runtime, graph
| summarize Sources = make_set(Source) by Id
| extend HasSensor = set_has_element(Sources, 'sensor')
| extend Name = tostring(split(Id, '/')[-1]), Rg = tostring(split(Id, '/')[4])
| project value = Id,
        label = strcat(Name, '  ·  ', Rg, iff(HasSensor, '', '  (no sensor telemetry)')),
        HasSensor
| order by HasSensor desc, label asc
| serialize
| extend selected = (row_number() == 1)
| project value, label, selected

content.json:
> **Cluster picker.** The list is built from two independent sources: the **Defender sensor** (`CloudProcessEvents`, `CloudDnsEvents`, `CloudAuditEvents`, `CloudPolicyEnforcementEvents`, last 30d) and the **exposure graph** (`ExposureGraphNodes`). A cluster tagged *no sensor telemetry* exists in the graph but sends no runtime data — its posture, identity and CVE panels work, the runtime, DNS and admission panels stay empty. That is a finding, not a broken workbook: it means Defender for Containers is not watching that cluster.
>
> An empty picker means neither source knows an AKS cluster in this tenant.

### Every AKS cluster, three sources deep
This tab ignores the cluster picker **and the time picker** — it is the fleet view, fixed to the full 30-day retention so a cluster that was deleted last week is still listed. Three independent sources answer three different questions, and the gaps between them are the point:

- **Advanced hunting telemetry** — clusters that are actually *sending* data. No row here means no sensor.
- **Exposure graph** — clusters Defender *knows about*, sensor or not, with their configuration flags. It is a snapshot and keeps recently deleted clusters for a while.
- **Azure Resource Graph** — clusters that *currently exist* in ARM, with node counts and versions. Present here but absent above = unmonitored. Present above but absent here = deleted.

content.title: Fleet at a glance (last 30 days)
content.query:
let isCluster = (s: string) { s has '/managedclusters/' and array_length(split(s, '/')) == 9 };
let clusters = materialize(
union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(AzureResourceId: string)[]),
    (CloudProcessEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | distinct AzureResourceId),
    (CloudDnsEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | distinct AzureResourceId),
    (CloudAuditEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | distinct AzureResourceId),
    (CloudPolicyEnforcementEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | distinct AzureResourceId)
    | where isCluster(tolower(AzureResourceId))
    | distinct ClusterId = tolower(AzureResourceId));
let clusterAlerts = materialize(
AlertEvidence
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and isnotempty(ResourceID) and isCluster(tolower(ResourceID))
    | distinct AlertId, ClusterId = tolower(ResourceID));
clusters | summarize Value = dcount(ClusterId) | extend Metric = 'Clusters sending telemetry'
| union (ExposureGraphNodes | where NodeLabel =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters'
         | summarize Value = dcount(NodeId) | extend Metric = 'Clusters in exposure graph')
| union (clusterAlerts | summarize Value = dcount(AlertId) | extend Metric = 'Alerts on clusters')
| union (clusterAlerts | summarize Value = dcount(ClusterId) | extend Metric = 'Clusters with alerts')
| union (CloudPolicyEnforcementEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and ActionType has 'Deny'
         | summarize Value = dcount(AzureResourceId) | extend Metric = 'Clusters with denies')
| union (CloudProcessEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | summarize Value = dcount(KubernetesNamespace)
         | extend Metric = 'Namespaces observed')
| union (CloudProcessEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | where isCluster(tolower(AzureResourceId))
         | project Timestamp, AzureResourceId
         | summarize LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by ClusterId = tolower(AzureResourceId)
         | summarize Value = countif(now() - LastSeen > 1d)
         | extend Metric = 'Clusters no longer reporting')
| project Metric, Value

content.title: Every cluster Defender sees — active and gone (last 30 days)
content.query:
let isCluster = (s: string) { s has '/managedclusters/' and array_length(split(s, '/')) == 9 };
// One row per cluster, folded from five tables. A cluster is ACTIVE while it is still sending
// telemetry; one that stopped is either deleted or has a dead sensor - both worth a row, which
// is why this is built from CloudProcessEvents rather than from an ARM inventory.
let runtime = CloudProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and isCluster(tolower(AzureResourceId))
    | project Timestamp, AzureResourceId, KubernetesNamespace, KubernetesPodName, ContainerImageName
    | summarize Namespaces = dcount(KubernetesNamespace, 0), Pods = dcount(KubernetesPodName, 0),
              Images = dcount(ContainerImageName, 0), Execs = count(),
              FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
          by ClusterId = tolower(AzureResourceId);
let dns = CloudDnsEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and isCluster(tolower(AzureResourceId))
    | project Timestamp, AzureResourceId, DnsQuery
    | summarize Domains = dcount(DnsQuery, 0), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
          by ClusterId = tolower(AzureResourceId);
let audit = CloudAuditEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and isCluster(tolower(AzureResourceId))
    | project Timestamp, AzureResourceId, User = tostring(RawEventData.User.username)
    | summarize ApiCalls = count(), Principals = dcount(User, 0),
              LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
          by ClusterId = tolower(AzureResourceId);
let adm = CloudPolicyEnforcementEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and isCluster(tolower(AzureResourceId))
    | summarize Denies = countif(ActionType has 'Deny'), Audits = countif(ActionType has 'Audit'),
              LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
          by ClusterId = tolower(AzureResourceId);
let alerts = AlertEvidence
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and isnotempty(ResourceID) and isCluster(tolower(ResourceID))
    | distinct AlertId, ClusterId = tolower(ResourceID)
    | join kind=leftouter (AlertInfo | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | project AlertId, Severity) on AlertId
    | summarize Alerts = dcount(AlertId), HighMed = dcountif(AlertId, Severity in~ ('High', 'Medium'))
          by ClusterId;
union runtime, dns, audit, adm, alerts
| summarize Alerts = coalesce(sum(Alerts), 0), HighMed = coalesce(sum(HighMed), 0),
          Denies = coalesce(sum(Denies), 0), Audits = coalesce(sum(Audits), 0),
          Namespaces = coalesce(sum(Namespaces), 0), Pods = coalesce(sum(Pods), 0),
          Images = coalesce(sum(Images), 0), Execs = coalesce(sum(Execs), 0),
          Domains = coalesce(sum(Domains), 0), ApiCalls = coalesce(sum(ApiCalls), 0),
          Principals = coalesce(sum(Principals), 0),
          FirstSeen = min(FirstSeen), LastSeen = max(LastSeen)
      by ClusterId
| extend SilentFor = now() - LastSeen
| extend State = case(SilentFor <= 1d, 'Active',
                      SilentFor <= 7d, 'Silent > 1d',
                      'Gone - deleted or sensor off')
| extend Cluster = tostring(split(ClusterId, '/')[-1]),
       ResourceGroup = tostring(split(ClusterId, '/')[4]),
       Subscription = tostring(split(ClusterId, '/')[2]),
       SilentForDays = round(SilentFor / 1d, 1)
| extend StateRank = case(State == 'Active', 0, State == 'Silent > 1d', 1, 2)
| project StateRank, State, Cluster, ResourceGroup, Alerts, HighMed, Denies, Audits, Namespaces, Pods,
        Images, Execs, Domains, ApiCalls, Principals, SilentForDays, FirstSeen, LastSeen,
        Subscription, ClusterId
| order by StateRank asc, Alerts desc, Execs desc
| project-away StateRank

content.query:
let cluster = '{ClusterId}';
let clusterName = tostring(split(cluster, '/')[-1]);
let alertIds = materialize(
AlertEvidence
    | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value}
    | where ResourceID =~ cluster or CloudResource =~ clusterName
    | distinct AlertId);
union isfuzzy=true
    (AlertInfo | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} | where AlertId in (alertIds)
        | summarize Value = dcount(AlertId) | extend Metric = 'Alerts'),
    (AlertInfo | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} | where AlertId in (alertIds) and Severity in ('High','Medium')
        | summarize Value = dcount(AlertId) | extend Metric = 'High + medium'),
    (CloudPolicyEnforcementEvents | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ cluster
        | summarize Value = countif(ActionType == 'Deny') | extend Metric = 'Admission denies'),
    (CloudPolicyEnforcementEvents | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ cluster
        | summarize Value = countif(ActionType == 'Audit') | extend Metric = 'Admission audits'),
    (CloudProcessEvents | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ cluster
        | summarize Value = dcount(KubernetesNamespace) | extend Metric = 'Namespaces'),
    (CloudProcessEvents | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ cluster
        | summarize Value = dcount(ContainerImageName) | extend Metric = 'Images running'),
    (CloudProcessEvents | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ cluster
        | summarize Value = dcount(HostName) | extend Metric = 'Nodes seen')
| project Metric, Value

content.json:
### Cross-signal — where to look first
Every section above looks at one table. These two fold them together: one signal is noise, two signals in the same namespace or the same pod is a lead.

content.title: Where to look first — namespace risk rollup
content.query:
let cluster = '{ClusterId}';
// Each leg contributes only the columns it owns. union pads the rest with nulls and the
// final summarize folds them on Namespace - a fullouter join would hand back EMPTY STRING
// keys (not null), which coalesce happily keeps, and the rollup splits into phantom rows.
let denies = CloudPolicyEnforcementEvents
    | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ cluster
    | summarize Denies = countif(ActionType has 'Deny'), Audits = countif(ActionType has 'Audit')
          by Namespace = KubernetesNamespace;
let runtime = CloudProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ cluster
    | summarize Pods = dcount(KubernetesPodName), Images = dcount(ContainerImageName),
              Shells = countif(ProcessName in~ ('sh','bash','zsh','ash','dash')),
              NetTools = countif(ProcessName in~ ('curl','wget','nc','ncat','socat','nmap'))
          by Namespace = KubernetesNamespace;
let egress = CloudDnsEvents
    | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ cluster
    | extend External = not(DnsQuery has '.cluster.local' or DnsQuery has '.svc')
    | summarize ExternalDomains = dcountif(DnsQuery, External),
              FailedLookups = countif(DnsResponseCodeName =~ 'NXDOMAIN')
          by Namespace = KubernetesNamespace;
let api = CloudAuditEvents
    | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ cluster
    | extend Namespace = tostring(RawEventData.ObjectRef.namespace),
           Sub = tostring(RawEventData.ObjectRef.subresource),
           Res = tostring(RawEventData.ObjectRef.resource),
           Code = toint(RawEventData.ResponseStatus.code)
    | summarize Execs = countif(Sub in~ ('exec','attach')), SecretReads = countif(Res =~ 'secrets'),
              DeniedCalls = countif(Code == 403)
          by Namespace;
union denies, runtime, egress, api
| extend Namespace = iff(isempty(Namespace), 'cluster-scoped', Namespace)
| where '*' in ({Namespace}) or Namespace in ({Namespace})
| summarize Pods = coalesce(sum(Pods), 0), Images = coalesce(sum(Images), 0),
          Denies = coalesce(sum(Denies), 0), Audits = coalesce(sum(Audits), 0),
          Shells = coalesce(sum(Shells), 0), NetTools = coalesce(sum(NetTools), 0),
          ExternalDomains = coalesce(sum(ExternalDomains), 0),
          FailedLookups = coalesce(sum(FailedLookups), 0),
          Execs = coalesce(sum(Execs), 0), SecretReads = coalesce(sum(SecretReads), 0),
          DeniedCalls = coalesce(sum(DeniedCalls), 0)
      by Namespace
| extend Attention = Denies * 5 + Shells * 2 + NetTools * 3 + Execs * 4
                   + SecretReads * 3 + DeniedCalls * 2
| order by Attention desc

content.title: Pods that ran a shell and then resolved external domains
content.query:
let cluster = '{ClusterId}';
let clusterName = tostring(split(cluster, '/')[-1]);
let shellPods = CloudProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ cluster
| where '*' in ({Namespace}) or KubernetesNamespace in ({Namespace})
    | where ProcessName in~ ('sh','bash','zsh','ash','dash','python','python3','perl')
    | summarize Shells = count(), Processes = make_set(ProcessName, 5),
              FirstShell = min(Timestamp), Image = take_any(ContainerImageName)
          by KubernetesNamespace, KubernetesPodName;
let extDns = CloudDnsEvents
    | where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ cluster
    | where not(DnsQuery has '.cluster.local' or DnsQuery has '.svc')
    | summarize ExternalDomains = dcount(DnsQuery), Domains = make_set(DnsQuery, 6),
              LastLookup = max(Timestamp)
          by KubernetesNamespace, KubernetesPodName;
shellPods
| join kind=inner extDns on KubernetesNamespace, KubernetesPodName
| project Namespace = KubernetesNamespace, Pod = KubernetesPodName, Image, Shells, Processes,
        ExternalDomains, Domains, FirstShell, LastLookup
| order by ExternalDomains desc, Shells desc
| take 40

### Runtime behaviour
`CloudProcessEvents` is the Defender sensor's view of what actually executed inside containers.

content.title: Process behaviour profile by namespace
content.query:
let cat = (p: string) { case(
      p in~ ('sh','bash','zsh','ash','dash'), 'shell',
      p in~ ('curl','wget','nc','ncat','socat','ssh','scp'), 'network tooling',
      p in~ ('nmap','tcpdump','ping','dig','nslookup','ip','ss','netstat'), 'recon',
      p in~ ('apt','apt-get','apk','yum','dnf','pip','pip3','npm'), 'package install',
      p in~ ('kubectl','crictl','docker','helm'), 'cluster tooling',
      p in~ ('chmod','chown','chattr','base64','openssl','gpg'), 'file or crypto',
      'application') };
CloudProcessEvents
| where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ '{ClusterId}'
| where '*' in ({Namespace}) or KubernetesNamespace in ({Namespace})
| extend Category = cat(ProcessName)
| summarize Executions = count(), Processes = dcount(ProcessName), Images = dcount(ContainerImageName),
          Pods = dcount(KubernetesPodName),
          Shell = countif(Category == 'shell'), Network = countif(Category == 'network tooling'),
          Recon = countif(Category == 'recon'), PkgInstall = countif(Category == 'package install'),
          ClusterTooling = countif(Category == 'cluster tooling')
      by Namespace = KubernetesNamespace
| extend NoisyRatio = round(todouble(Shell + Network + Recon + PkgInstall) / todouble(Executions), 3)
| order by NoisyRatio desc, Executions desc

| where Timestamp {TimeRange:value} and AzureResourceId =~ '{ClusterId}'

#### Identity reach — pod to Azure
The pivot that turns a container compromise into a data incident: the cluster's own identities (control plane, **kubelet**, add-ons and workload identities) and the Azure services they can reach. Kubelet is the one to watch — every pod on that node shares it.

content.title: Cluster identities and what they can reach
PaaS services reachable from this cluster's identities
content.query:
let clusterId = '{ClusterId}';
let clusterName = tostring(split(clusterId, '/')[-1]);
let rg = tostring(split(clusterId, '/')[4]);
let nodeRgHint = strcat('/mc_', tolower(rg), '_', tolower(clusterName), '_');
let clusterIdentities = materialize(
ExposureGraphNodes
    | where NodeLabel in~ ('managedidentity', 'serviceprincipal')
    | extend Raw = todynamic(NodeProperties).rawData
    | extend Alt = tolower(tostring(Raw.alternativeNames)),
           Display = tostring(Raw.accountDisplayName)
    // three ways an identity belongs to a cluster, all observed in the graph:
    //   control plane  -> alternativeNames carries the cluster resource id
    //   kubelet/addons -> they live in the node resource group MC_<rg>_<cluster>_<region>
    //   workload ids   -> user-assigned identities in the cluster's own resource group
    | where Alt has tolower(clusterId)
        or Alt has nodeRgHint
        or (Alt has strcat('/resourcegroups/', tolower(rg), '/') and Alt has 'userassignedidentities')
    | extend Role = case(
          Display endswith '-agentpool' or Alt has '-agentpool', 'kubelet (node pool)',
          Display startswith 'azurepolicy' or Alt has 'azurepolicy', 'addon: azure policy',
          Display startswith 'omsagent' or Alt has 'omsagent', 'addon: monitoring',
          Alt has tolower(clusterId) and Alt has 'isexplicit=false', 'cluster control plane',
          'workload identity / other')
    | project NodeId, IdentityName = coalesce(Display, NodeName), Role, NodeLabel);
ExposureGraphEdges
| where SourceNodeId in ((clusterIdentities | project NodeId))
| where EdgeLabel in~ ('has permissions to', 'has role on', 'controls access to')
// the services that make a container compromise a data incident
| where TargetNodeLabel has_any ('storage', 'keyvault', 'sql', 'cosmos', 'servicebus',
                                 'eventhub', 'containerregistry', 'operationalinsights',

let clusterId = '{ClusterId}';

    | where EdgeLabel =~ 'affecting' and SourceNodeLabel =~ 'Cve' and TargetNodeLabel =~ 'container-image'

    | where TargetNodeName has_any (repoList)
    | project CveNodeId = SourceNodeId, ImageName = TargetNodeName
    | extend Repo = repoOf(ImageName)
    | join kind=inner runningImages on Repo
    | join kind=inner cveMeta on CveNodeId);
imageCves
| summarize Value = dcount(Cve) | extend Metric = 'CVEs total'
| union (imageCves | where Severity in~ ('Critical', 'High') | summarize Value = dcount(Cve) | extend Metric = 'Critical + high')
| union (imageCves | where HasExploit == true | summarize Value = dcount(Cve) | extend Metric = 'With known exploit')

---
**Data sources** — `AlertInfo`, `AlertEvidence`, `SecurityIncident`, `CloudPolicyEnforcementEvents` (preview), `CloudProcessEvents`, `CloudDnsEvents`, `ExposureGraphNodes`, `ExposureGraphEdges`. All queries run natively against Defender XDR advanced hunting (`queryType: 1`, 30-day retention); no Log Analytics ingestion.

**Dependencies** — Defender for Containers with the sensor deployed (process and DNS events), gated deployment enabled (admission events), Defender for Cloud connected to the Defender portal, Security Exposure Management for the graph tables, and Sentinel onboarded to the Defender portal for `SecurityIncident` open/closed state.

**Caveats** — `AlertInfo` has no status column, so incident state comes from `SecurityIncident`. The new-process panel compares a fixed 7-day window against the prior 23 days and ignores the time-range picker on purpose.
